integrity: Exact finite-dimensional covariance derivation, rational Sturm and Routh tests, source-method algebra, and standalone symbolic verification. A literature comparison is documented, but bibliographic uniqueness is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar pure delay, lag and step both one, independently sampled stages, exact arithmetic; almost-sure stability and other mesh ratios are not treated.
title: A sharp mean-square stability boundary for randomized Runge–Kutta integration of a pure-delay equation
